title: Drift Away 30A | KEY.co
description_expanded: Inside, three thoughtfully designed levels provide exceptional comfort and space for gathering. The open-concept main living area features elegant furnishings, a fireplace, and a gourmet kitchen with marble island and premium appliances, perfect for shared meals and celebrations. Multiple king suites, bunk rooms, and private baths ensure both privacy and relaxation, while an elevator adds convenience throughout the home. From sunset views on the rooftop deck to poolside afternoons and evenings spent together indoors, this stunning Old Seagrove escape offers a seamless blend of luxury, comfort, and coastal beauty. Drift Away 30A is a newly built luxury retreat tucked beneath the timeless oaks and magnolias of Old Seagrove, just 250 steps from the sugar-white sands and turquoise waters of the Gulf. Designed for unforgettable coastal escapes, this expansive eight-bedroom, eight-and-a-half-bath home blends refined style with resort-style amenities, including a private pool and jacuzzi, outdoor kitchen and bar, rooftop deck with sweeping Gulf views, and a lively game room. Complimentary seasonal beach service, a six-seater golf cart, and six adult bikes make exploring the charm of 30A effortless.

Features: Guests assume all risk for use of pools
